jobs.title: Part-Time Business Support Administrator (Remote)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part-Time Business Support Administrator (Remote)


Location: Fully Remote (UK-based, ideally South of England)

Hours: 12–20 hours per week (flexible Monday–Friday)

Contract: Permanent

Salary: Competitive hourly rate (dependent on experience)


Join Harper Water Management Group

Harper Water Management Group is an independent consultancy providing specialist advice and technical support for the safe management and use of water and wastewater systems across healthcare and non-healthcare sectors.

As our business continues to grow, we're looking for a proactive and organised Business Support Administrator to become a key member of our team.

This is more than an administration role. You'll help keep our business running smoothly while supporting consultants, coordinating projects and improving the systems that support our continued growth.


What You'll Do

You'll play a central role in the day-to-day operation of the business by:

  • Supporting our consultancy team with administrative tasks
  • Preparing reports, quotations and technical documents
  • Raising invoices and assisting with financial administration
  • Managing consultant diaries, meetings and Water Safety Audits
  • Liaising professionally with clients and external organisations
  • Maintaining and improving business systems and processes
  • Supporting project tracking and workload planning


About You

You'll be someone who enjoys being organised, solving problems and keeping things running efficiently.

We're looking for someone with:

  • Previous administration or business support experience
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities independently
  • A professional, proactive and dependable approach


Experience within consultancy, professional services or financial administration would be an advantage, but is not essential.


Why Join Harper Water?

✔ Fully remote working

✔ Flexible part-time hours

✔ Genuine responsibility from day one

✔ Opportunity to help shape a growing business

✔ Friendly, supportive team environment

✔ A role with scope to grow as the business grows


Interested?

We'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a short covering email explaining why you'd be a great fit for Harper Water Management Group to info@harperwater.com

jobs.title: Office Administrator - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Office Administrator

Part-Time

Location: Drighlington, West Yorkshire

Hours: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 12:00pm

Rate of Pay: £13.00 per hour

We are seeking a reliable and organised Office Administrator to join our client in Drighlington. This part-time role is ideal for someone who enjoys providing comprehensive administrative support across various departments including production, finance, sales and customer support, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office. The successful candidate will be proactive, professional, and adept at managing multiple tasks while maintaining excellent attention to detail.

Day-to-day of the role:

  • Provide general administrative support to the business, with a focus on supporting the production, finance, and customer support departments
  • Handle incoming telephone calls and emails professionally, serving as the first point of contact for various department inquiries
  • Greet visitors and assist with reception duties when required
  • Manage filing, scanning, and maintaining accurate records and documentation across different departments
  • Update internal databases and spreadsheets relevant to production schedules, financial records, and customer interactions
  • Prepare correspondence, reports, and other documents that support business operations
  • Order office supplies and monitor stock levels, ensuring all departments are well-equipped
  • Assist with scheduling appointments, coordinating diaries, and organising meetings across departments
  • Process incoming and outgoing post, including documents related to production and finance
  • Support various departments with ad hoc administrative tasks as needed
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with company procedures across all areas of support

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in an administrative role supporting multiple business areas such as production, finance, or customer support
  • Strong organisational and time management skills, capable of managing tasks across various departments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, liaising with different departments effectively
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Professional and friendly manner
  • Positive, flexible, and willing-to-help attitude

Benefits:

  • Competitive pay of £13.00 per hour
  • Part-time working hours with a great work-life balance
  • Friendly and supportive working environment
  • Opportunity to develop skills within a varied administrative role, supporting key business areas
